topic_title: Traffic Control Devices: Legal Foundation & Enforcement
prompt: What criminal charge applies to intentionally altering, knocking down, or defacing an official traffic sign?

options.text: A standard administrative non-criminal warning with zero consequences
A minor local parking fine payable within thirty calendar days
Civil restitution limited to fifty dollars for state paint replacement
A misdemeanor or felony offense punishable by severe fines and jail time
